decisive_spans.text: Serial imaging over two weeks showed rapid enlargement of the mass

response.rationale: Langerhans cell histiocytosis is supported by the destructive lesion, soft-tissue involvement, and rapid enlargement of the mass. Ewing sarcoma is also supported by the destructive lesion, rapid enlargement, and T2 hyperintensity, but it is contradicted by the normal C-reactive protein level. The other candidates are less well supported or have contradictions.
